verdict.rationale: The evidence pack never shows AI drafting answers to inbound customer security questionnaires from the company's own controls or knowledge base. The closest item, Comply AI extracting answers from vendor SOC 2 reports, covers outbound vendor risk review, which is the opposite direction from this sales-lead story. The Trust Center offers self-serve document sharing, not questionnaire answering, and the other AI features cover policies, risk scoring and SSPs.
